note: Seed data for the noon keep/drop model. This is NOT meant to grow into an
exhaustive list of every noon-bearing word - that does not scale. It is a
starting set for the words whose ghunna cannot be read off the spelling.
The scalable source is a `noon_ghunna` table in the scansion database,
which takes precedence over this file when present.
Entries are stems, not inflected forms. When the flagged noon sits in a
nasal+stop cluster no suffix can break it up, so the flag is inherited by
longer words: جھانک answers for جھانکتے، جھانکتی، جھانکنا. A stem with no
such cluster, like جان, answers only for itself and leaves جانب alone.
decision: drop   = نونِ غنہ, the noon carries no weight (چاند counts as چاد)
decision: either = the word scans both ways and the bahr decides (جان / جاں)
decision: keep   = نونِ اصلی or نونِ شبہِ غنہ; this is also the default, so
it is only worth writing down to override a stem match

entries.note: جھانْک - the noon nasalises the ا and is not counted; covers جھانکتے، جھانکنا
چانْد counts as چاد; covers چاندنی، چاندی
reads as جان or جاں depending on the meter
